import pandas as pd

def main():
    # File paths for all sources
    path_source_0 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/test_0.csv"
    path_source_1 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/test_1.csv"
    path_source_2 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/test_2.csv"
    path_source_3 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/test_3.csv"
    path_source_4 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/test_4.csv"

    # Output path
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/target_multisource_cot.csv"

    # Load source tables
    df_interv = pd.read_csv(path_source_0)  # ['IdInterv', 'Intervencion']
    df_detecc = pd.read_csv(path_source_1)  # ['IdDeteccion', 'Deteccion']
    df_main = pd.read_csv(path_source_2)    # main big table with most columns
    df_actividad = pd.read_csv(path_source_3)  # ['IdActividad', 'Actividad']
    df_causa = pd.read_csv(path_source_4)      # ['IdCausa', 'Causa']

    # --- Step 1: Prepare main dataframe ---
    # Rename columns if needed to avoid conflicts on merge
    # The main df already has columns: Intervencion, Deteccion, Actividad, Causa as strings
    # and also IdInterv, IdDeteccion, IdActividad, IdCausa are missing in main df, so we will add them by mapping

    # --- Step 2: Map Intervencion to IdInterv ---
    # The main df has 'Intervencion' as string, map to IdInterv from df_interv
    # Merge left on 'Intervencion' to get IdInterv
    df_main = df_main.merge(df_interv, on='Intervencion', how='left', suffixes=('', '_from_interv'))
    # After merge, df_main has columns: IdInterv (from df_interv), Intervencion (original)
    # The IdInterv column from df_interv is the one we want, but it may be duplicated if original df_main had IdInterv (it doesn't)
    # Rename to ensure correct column
    # The merge will add a new 'IdInterv' column from df_interv, so no rename needed

    # --- Step 3: Map Deteccion to IdDeteccion ---
    # The main df has 'Deteccion' as string, map to IdDeteccion from df_detecc
    df_main = df_main.merge(df_detecc, on='Deteccion', how='left', suffixes=('', '_from_detecc'))
    # Now df_main has IdDeteccion column from df_detecc

    # --- Step 4: Map Actividad to IdActividad ---
    # The main df has 'Actividad' as string, map to IdActividad from df_actividad
    df_main = df_main.merge(df_actividad, on='Actividad', how='left', suffixes=('', '_from_actividad'))
    # Now df_main has IdActividad column from df_actividad

    # --- Step 5: Map Causa to IdCausa ---
    # The main df has 'Causa' as string, map to IdCausa from df_causa
    df_main = df_main.merge(df_causa, on='Causa', how='left', suffixes=('', '_from_causa'))
    # Now df_main has IdCausa column from df_causa

    # --- Step 6: Select and reorder columns to match target schema ---
    # Target schema:
    # ['Fecha': string, 'IdAhogado': integer, 'IdPersona': integer, 'Localidad': string, 'Provincia': string, 'CCAA': string,
    #  'Hora': string, 'Latitud_inc': float, 'Longitud_inc': float, 'Sexo': string, 'Edad': float, 'Nacionalidad': string,
    #  'Origen': string, 'Extraccion': string, 'Causa': string, 'TipoAhogamiento': string, 'Factor': string,
    #  'Intervencion': string, 'Pronostico': string, 'Localizacion': string, 'Riesgo': string, 'Reanimacion': string,
    #  'Vigilancia': string, 'Actividad': string, 'Deteccion': string, 'ID': integer, 'Estacion': string, 'Estado': string,
    #  'Latitud_est': float, 'Longitud_est': float, 'T_med': float, 'T_max': float, 'T_min': float, 'Presion': float,
    #  'Dir. vi.': float, 'V_Viento': integer, 'Nubosidad': float, 'ProfNievecm': float, 'InsolacHoras': float, 'Distancia': float,
    #  'IdActividad': integer, 'IdCausa': integer, 'IdDeteccion': integer, 'IdInterv': integer]

    # Note: Source main df has 'Precipitaciones' column which is not in target schema, so drop it.
    # Also, the target schema column order must be respected.

    # Check if all columns exist in df_main, if not create with NaNs or appropriate types
    # For safety, fill missing columns with NaN or appropriate default

    # Columns to keep and order:
    target_columns = [
        'Fecha', 'IdAhogado', 'IdPersona', 'Localidad', 'Provincia', 'CCAA', 'Hora',
        'Latitud_inc', 'Longitud_inc', 'Sexo', 'Edad', 'Nacionalidad', 'Origen', 'Extraccion',
        'Causa', 'TipoAhogamiento', 'Factor', 'Intervencion', 'Pronostico', 'Localizacion',
        'Riesgo', 'Reanimacion', 'Vigilancia', 'Actividad', 'Deteccion', 'ID', 'Estacion',
        'Estado', 'Latitud_est', 'Longitud_est', 'T_med', 'T_max', 'T_min', 'Presion',
        'Dir. vi.', 'V_Viento', 'Nubosidad', 'ProfNievecm', 'InsolacHoras', 'Distancia',
        'IdActividad', 'IdCausa', 'IdDeteccion', 'IdInterv'
    ]

    # Some columns might be missing in df_main after merges, ensure they exist
    for col in target_columns:
        if col not in df_main.columns:
            df_main[col] = pd.NA

    # Select and reorder columns
    df_target = df_main[target_columns]

    # --- Step 7: Data type conversions ---
    # Convert columns to target types as specified

    # Fecha: string (keep as is)
    # IdAhogado, IdPersona, ID, IdActividad, IdCausa, IdDeteccion, IdInterv: integer
    int_cols = ['IdAhogado', 'IdPersona', 'ID', 'IdActividad', 'IdCausa', 'IdDeteccion', 'IdInterv']
    for col in int_cols:
        df_target[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_target[col], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

    # Float columns:
    float_cols = ['Latitud_inc', 'Longitud_inc', 'Edad', 'Latitud_est', 'Longitud_est', 'T_med', 'T_max', 'T_min',
                  'Presion', 'Dir. vi.', 'Nubosidad', 'ProfNievecm', 'InsolacHoras', 'Distancia']
    for col in float_cols:
        df_target[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_target[col], errors='coerce')

    # V_Viento: integer
    df_target['V_Viento'] = pd.to_numeric(df_target['V_Viento'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

    # The rest are strings, ensure string type and fill NaNs with empty string or keep as is
    str_cols = [col for col in target_columns if col not in int_cols + float_cols + ['Fecha', 'V_Viento']]
    for col in str_cols:
        df_target[col] = df_target[col].astype('string')

    # --- Step 8: Export to CSV ---
    df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
